indication_area: Inflammatory bowel disease (ulcerative colitis, Crohn's disease)
formulation: lyophilized powder for injection (intravenous); subcutaneous pen added later

approval_evidence.quote: Under this license, you are authorized to manufacture the product Entyvio (vedolizumab). (FDA approval letter, BLA 125476, signed 05/20/2014)

notes: Launch quarter: Takeda's Q1 FY2014 financial statements text (https://assets-dam.takeda.com/raw/upload/v1662727509/legacy-dotcom/siteassets/system/investors/quarterly-announcements/fy2014/qr2014_q1_f_en.pdf) states 'In the U.S., in June 2014, Takeda launched ENTYVIO'. Takeda fiscal quarters (April-March year) align with calendar quarters; FY Q1 = Apr-Jun maps to calendar Q2. Takeda reports JPY billions to one decimal. Basis changes: FY2014 quarters come from JGAAP-era and IFRS-comparative documents (derived rows 2014Q3 and 2015Q1 are approximate, 0.1 billion JPY); FY2015 onward IFRS. The printed line is worldwide product revenue (Takeda's footnote in the FY2017 data book and FY2024 report says sales amount includes royalty income and service income).
search_log: downloaded takeda.com quarterly-results pages for 2012-2025 and the current page (15 pages) and collected every PDF/XLSX link (cache/takeda_links.json)
scanned every qr20xx_q?/full PDF on those pages with pdftotext for the product labels, then read the matching pages with pdfplumber (the verifier's extractor) so quoted figures match its text layer

FY2014 (JGAAP) documents carry no Entyvio table line for Q1/Q2; FY2015 onward are IFRS; the product-table pages were located per fiscal quarter (data books FY2016-FY2019, quarterly financial reports FY2020-FY2026)

EDGAR (Takeda CIK 0001395064) was indexed through data.sec.gov submissions (6-K, 6-K/A, 20-F, 20-F/A) but the takeda.com copies of the same quarterly documents were cited instead, because the 6-K earnings exhibits were not individually resolved
cross-check: for every fiscal year the four quarterly values were summed and compared with the full-year product figure printed in the Q4 document (differences at most 0.2 billion JPY from rounding)
